rationale.reason: Complete refrigerated cargo vessels fit 8901.30; fishing processors, tankers and container-only vessels are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This candidate PCR covers new complete steel-hulled diesel refrigerated cargo ships, with fixed insulated refrigerated holds and actual R717 anhydrous-ammonia refrigeration. Mechanical-diesel and diesel-electric arrangements, direct ammonia and secondary-brine systems are separate declared configurations. The boundary is narrower than CPC 49313. Exclude tankers, fishing/catching or onboard-processing vessels, passenger ships, container-only refrigeration vessels, other hull materials, alternative-fuel/hybrid propulsion, non-ammonia refrigeration, bare hulls, conversion/repair and transport service. One accepted finished unit means one complete vessel, with Chinese 设备 carrying the same measurement meaning.

Collect actual receipt-to-shipyard-delivery fabrication, joining, coating, machinery/outfitting, fixed cold-hold integration, launch and attributable construction trials/rework. Supplier production requires explicit links before any complete cradle-to-gate claim. Exclude cargo production, voyages, customer refrigeration energy, freight output, maintenance and end of life; no lifetime or tonne-distance equivalence. Shipyard and independent equipment-manufacturer originals establish possible architecture only, not mandatory chemistry, manufacturing intensity or current certificates. Scientific review remains pending. [Sources: kyokuyo-reefer; gea-reefer]
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete steel-hulled diesel fixed-hold refrigerated cargo ships with actual R717 refrigeration
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Tankers, fishing/processing, passenger and container-only vessels; other hull/propulsion/refrigerants; intermediates, repairs and services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted shipyard-delivery vessel; installed refrigeration charge and service fluids included, operational consumables excluded from M

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New complete steel-hulled diesel refrigerated cargo vessel with fixed insulated holds and actual R717 ammonia refrigeration; mechanical diesel or diesel-electric documented separately. Narrower than CPC49313. Exclude tankers, fishing/catching/onboard-processing vessels, passenger ferries, container-only reefer transport vessels, other hull materials or alternative/hybrid propulsion, non-ammonia refrigeration, bare hull intermediates, repairs/conversions, operational cargo cooling and freight service. Passenger ferry and vessel-component/land refrigeration PCRs have distinct product and manufacturing acceptance gates; no same complete vessel material PCR in this checkout.

unresolved_quantity_ranges: No current actual same-vessel net M or independent boundary-compatible manufacture intensity ranges are provided; later foreground records must establish amounts and QA limits.
evidence_limitations: PCR describes required current acceptance-mass provenance; no actual ship acceptance/weight record has been obtained or certified. Finite measurement consistency does not verify actual ship mass or scientific approval.

Historical 2020 Norwegian procedure is a limited method example, not confirmed current universal law. Undated shipyard and equipment-manufacturer architecture statements do not prove actual configuration, chemical recipe, capacity or certification.

No universal recipe, grade approval, vessel mass, lifetime, trial fuel use or emission factor adopted. Every actual BOM/species/service must be added; missing supplier upstream prevents complete cradle-to-gate claims.
